cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.
